description:
Execute the frozen M4RI matched-operation comparison against the dense gf2 consumer and publish both operation and adapter-inclusive observations.

## Background

Only the qualified consuming operation is measured. Transpose or BCH-generator results are not substitutes. Matrix construction, representation conversion, execution, and output materialization stay visible in the whole-consumer arm.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The receipt contains raw samples, exact external build and run commands, content-pinned matrices, runtime path evidence, statistical interpretation, and all construction, adapter, conversion, and output costs.
- [hard] REQ-02: Semantically equivalent output is demonstrated for the frozen dimensions and boundary cells, with isolated operation throughput reported separately from consumer benefit.
- [hard] REQ-03: Losing, inconclusive, unmatched, or unavailable cells remain in the committed evidence without triggering production adoption.

## Notes

Run only in the benchmark window on the prepared host under the full-host wrapper.
title: Measure the M4RI dense comparison
